scope: Static native FK comparing box and exploratory capsule at retained last-front-contact joint states and counterfactual proximal angles, with endpoint velocities supplied only to satisfy input shape. No dynamic contact response, actuator feasibility or biological inference. Gap is collision-box geometric bottom minus ground, not exact solver separation. Toe box dimensions +/- (9, 2.5, 9.2) mm. q at substep and ground reference sampling may have rounding differences.
